newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto-Dominion Bank Q2 loan loss falls.
newsitem.headline: Toronto-Dominion Bank Q2 loan loss falls.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank Bank said on Thursday that its second quarter provision for loan losses dropped to C$40 million from C$42 million in the year ago period.

The bank said in a released statement that its net impaired loans declined to C$367 million from C$514 million at the end of last quarter and C$395 million a year ago as the overall trend toward improved credit quality on corporate loans continued.
TD said its estimate for the provision for credit losses for 1997 remains unchanged from last quarter at C$160 million.
